name: Nanamori Kurumi
source:
The alternate reality version of [url=http://vndb.org/c13947]Miruku[/url] she lives with her brother [url=http://vndb.org/c13945]Akira[/url] while their mother is away on business. She is extremely jealous for her brother and wants to be his only girl. This causes her to be at odds with Miruku especially.

For some reason she is especially bad at magic and cannot keep her transformation for more than a few seconds.
